title: IR access
note: The one storage model: which storage an instruction touches. The verifier's self-tests and the error and value tests exercise it.

title: Conversions
note: Implicit and explicit conversions. TypeSelfTests checks the properties on random types; error and value tests print the conversions a program uses.

title: Place paths

title: Emitter: types

title: Emitter: bodies

title: Interpreter: cells and values
note: The cells a place is, and the value kinds. Every program has places and values, so the whole suite is the covering set.

title: Interpreter: frames and control flow
note: Frames, locals, calls, returns, blocks and their release order. Every program has frames and control flow, so the whole suite is the covering set.

title: Interpreter: operands and places
note: Operands, places, and the rvalue visitors: the instruction set's meaning as an expression. Every program evaluates operands and places, so the whole suite is the covering set.

title: Interpreter: calls and destruction
note: Construction, dispatch, destruction, and the release order that mirrors C++ parameter destruction. Every program calls and destroys, so the whole suite is the covering set.

title: Interpreter: function values
note: Lambdas, closures, choices, and invocation. Lambda and generic tests exercise both forms.

title: Interpreter: raw memory
note: Buffers, pointers, spans, and the Memory intrinsics, as runtime/wyl/intrinsics.h implements them.

title: Interpreter: intrinsics
note: The builtins and the standard library's extern methods. They cover String, the containers, spans, memory, and Weak, which every part of the suite uses, so the whole suite is the covering set.

title: Interpreter: cycle collector
note: The port of runtime/wyl/cycles.h, down to its stats and debug diagnostics. Cycle tests pin the order and the messages.

title: Interpreter: text
note: Formatting, interpolation, and String's members, which must print exactly what runtime/wyl/*.h does.

title: Interpreter: arithmetic
note: Checked arithmetic and conversions, as runtime/wyl/arithmetic.h implements them: panics, wrapping, shifts, and conversions.

title: Interpreter: results
note: The result statuses, the abort exit code, and the text a panic or a budget writes. The panic tests and the interpreted matrix cells pin them.
